children: President Donald Trump touted the U.S.'s strength and economy, saying, "America is back and our country is stronger than it ever was before,'
in an address to the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday.
"We're leading in virtually everything," he added.
The poverty rate in the U.S. is the lowest in its history.
Real household incomes "have soared to the highest level in history."
The stock market set 80 all-time records in the last 12 month.
The administration has secured $21T in investments in the U.S.
The murder rate fell to the lowest level in 125 years.
The U.S. has invested $1.5T in the military.
Trump spoke about his actions against Iran, saying that Iran's "economy is gone." He made it clear his grievance was not against the Iranian people but of its current regime.
More oil is flowing than at any point since the start of the war, he said.
"I believe we'll make a deal right after the election," he said. "It doesn't make sense for them (Iran) not to."
He disputed reports that the U.S. is running low on munitions due to the Iran war. "We have more munitions than we can ever possibly think of using," Trump said.
"I call on all nations to join us and force the complete isolation of Iran," he said.
Furthermore, he once again predicted that oil prices will plummet once the Iran war ends.
Trump predicted an end to the Russia-Ukraine war very soon.

title: Trump says U.S. is 'leading in virtually everything' in UN address
